scenario_text: You are an army officer in the Dominican Republic in 1961. For decades now, your country has been governed by a dictator who has had thousands of people killed because of their ethnicity or their political views. You are a member of a group that wants a new start for your country without a civil war. To achieve this goal, you consider it unavoidable to kill the dictator in order to disempower him, his family, and his followers. For this, you and six co-conspirators are asked to ambush and kill the dictator. If you kill the dictator, the people in your country will have a chance for a new start. If you do not kill him, the regime will continue its killings.
